before: Compact replacement refused every equation whose structures carried control properties (m:ctrlPr).
after: When every m:ctrlPr in an equation holds the same default formatting, compact replacement is available and writes a copy of the first m:ctrlPr on each structure it creates. Other control properties keep the refusal.
reason: The setMathEquation operation shape is unchanged. Peers receive the replaced equation as ordinary canonical OMML nodes, which released clients already preserve. The change affects local replacement output and capability, not the room format.
